name: @flowforge/webhook
description: FlowForge build-static fire-and-forget webhook rule runtime (A29 / EP1-9) — receives verified webhook deliveries, matches them against registered rules, and creates a Workspace-backed Session running in the background. Ported from dsh `dsh-webhook` and rebuilt as an injected-seam design: every originally-cordis host service (agent factory, agent default model, agent presets, permission presets, session-title, workspace registry, invariants, llm helpers, brand, util-values) is expressed as a package-local port plus a real in-memory implementation; there are no @deepseek-ai/* or @cat-cafe/* runtime references.
